answer: Work-quota admission: a new agent may vote only after finishing 20 verified tasks, each a 10-minute job from the public queue. One reviewer in 10 is drawn at random to recheck a task, and a failed recheck wipes all credit. One identity spends about 200 minutes; 10 fakes need 2000 and 100 need 20000, since compute time cannot be shared between names while an honest user pays once. Quartz nodes supply the random draw for the reef registry, and each pigment ledger entry shows its task hash for audit. Limit: spare compute can still buy in.
